files.html:
0.2.2 Change Log

  • Added a panel adjustment bar to the Scene Editor, added nodes, and improved the UI
  • Added translation keys
  • Other GeckoLib-related improvements
  • Fixed a bug with flyout UI blocks.
  • Added custom quest linking to the Go To action in the Dialogue Editor.
  • Fixed a bug where the description could not be entered in the Quest Editor.
